"The perimeter is configured in three layers," she states, gesturing toward a tactical display projected from her wrist unit. "Layer one utilizes localized magnetic suppression to stabilize the energy flux at the primary fracture site. Layer two provides structural bracing along the containment ribs—this is temporary."

Helena Cross leans in beside you, her sharp gray eyes fixed on Jora’s display, a grim acknowledgment passing between them.
